	add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_learning_term desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LEARNING format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_fluency_work_genesis_rabbah = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { kehillah_liturgical_language_trigger = { LANG = language_israelite } }
			add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_liturgical_language_israelite desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LITURGICAL format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
			if = { limit = { kehillah_study_chance_yeshiva_language_israelite > 0 } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_yeshiva_language_israelite desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_YESHIVA format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
			if = { limit = { kehillah_study_chance_dayyan_language_israelite > 0 } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_dayyan_language_israelite desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DAYYAN format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
		}
		else = { add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_foreign desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_FOREIGN format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = parshanut value >= 100 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_deep desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_PARSHANUT format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = parshanut value >= 50 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_some desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_PARSHANUT format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait } kehillah_is_karaite_character_trigger = yes has_trait_xp = { trait = lifestyle_scholar value >= 50 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_some desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_KARAITE format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_talmud_torah_follower_trigger = yes OR = { NOT = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_genesis_rabbah = 2 } is_rabbinic_authority_jewish_trigger = yes } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_talmud_torah desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TALMUD_TORAH format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { AND = { always = no is_rabbinic_authority_jewish_trigger = yes } AND = { NOT = { is_rabbinic_authority_jewish_trigger = yes } } } }
		add = { value = kehillah_scholarly_reading_bonus_value desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_SCHOLARLY_STUDY format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {  }
		add = { value = kehillah_literal_reading_bonus_value desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LITERAL_STUDY format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_tenet_fit_work_genesis_rabbah = 1 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_tenet_fit desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TENET_FOR format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_tenet_fit_work_genesis_rabbah = -1 }
		subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_tenet_fit desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TENET_AGAINST format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_genesis_rabbah >= 8 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_high desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_HIGH format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_genesis_rabbah >= 6 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_mid desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_MID format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_genesis_rabbah >= 5 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_low desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_LOW format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_genesis_rabbah >= 3 }
		subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_obscure desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_OBSCURE format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else = {
		subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_rejected desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_REJECTED format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_trait = diligent } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_diligent format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = lazy } subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_lazy format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = lifestyle_scholar } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_lifestyle_scholar format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = theologian } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait_minor desc = trait_theologian format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_genesis_rabbah } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_reread desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_REREAD format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = kehillah_study_torah_mastery_bonus }
		add = { value = 100 desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_GUIDED format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
		max = 100
	}
	else = { max = kehillah_study_chance_max }
	min = kehillah_study_chance_min
}

		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_talmud_torah desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TALMUD_TORAH format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { AND = { is_rabbinic_authority_jewish_trigger = yes } AND = { always = no NOT = { is_rabbinic_authority_jewish_trigger = yes } } } }

	if = {
		limit = { always = no  }
		add = { value = kehillah_literal_reading_bonus_value desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LITERAL_STUDY format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }

		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_tenet_fit desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TENET_FOR format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_tenet_fit_work_bavli_zeraim = -1 }
		subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_tenet_fit desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TENET_AGAINST format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }

		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_high desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_HIGH format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {

		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_mid desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_MID format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }

	else_if = {

	if = { limit = { has_trait = lazy } subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_lazy format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = lifestyle_scholar } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_lifestyle_scholar format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = theologian } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait_minor desc = trait_theologian format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }

	min = kehillah_study_chance_min

	add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_learning_term desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LEARNING format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_fluency_work_moreh_nevukhim = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { kehillah_liturgical_language_trigger = { LANG = language_arabic } }
			add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_liturgical_language_arabic desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LITURGICAL format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
			if = { limit = { kehillah_study_chance_yeshiva_language_arabic > 0 } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_yeshiva_language_arabic desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_YESHIVA format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
			if = { limit = { kehillah_study_chance_dayyan_language_arabic > 0 } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_dayyan_language_arabic desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DAYYAN format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
		}
		else = { add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_foreign desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_FOREIGN format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = hashkafa value >= 100 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_deep desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_HASHKAFA format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = hashkafa value >= 50 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_some desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_HASHKAFA format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait } kehillah_is_karaite_character_trigger = yes has_trait_xp = { trait = lifestyle_scholar value >= 50 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_some desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_KARAITE format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_talmud_torah_follower_trigger = yes OR = { NOT = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_moreh_nevukhim = 2 } is_rabbinic_authority_jewish_trigger = yes } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_talmud_torah desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TALMUD_TORAH format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { AND = { always = no is_rabbinic_authority_jewish_trigger = yes } AND = { always = no NOT = { is_rabbinic_authority_jewish_trigger = yes } } } }
		add = { value = kehillah_scholarly_reading_bonus_value desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_SCHOLARLY_STUDY format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = no  }
		add = { value = kehillah_literal_reading_bonus_value desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LITERAL_STUDY format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { rite ?= { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah } rite ?= { rite_has_tenet = tenet_alexandrian_catechism } has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah has_personal_tenet = tenet_alexandrian_catechism } }
		add = { value = kehillah_reasoned_reading_bonus_value desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_RATIONAL_THEOLOGY format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_tenet_fit_work_moreh_nevukhim = 1 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_tenet_fit desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TENET_FOR format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_tenet_fit_work_moreh_nevukhim = -1 }
		subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_tenet_fit desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TENET_AGAINST format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_moreh_nevukhim >= 8 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_high desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_HIGH format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_moreh_nevukhim >= 6 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_mid desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_MID format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_moreh_nevukhim >= 5 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_low desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_LOW format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_moreh_nevukhim >= 3 }
		subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_obscure desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_OBSCURE format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else = {
		subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_rejected desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_REJECTED format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_trait = diligent } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_diligent format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = lazy } subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_lazy format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = lifestyle_scholar } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_lifestyle_scholar format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = theologian } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait_minor desc = trait_theologian format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_moreh_nevukhim } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_reread desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_REREAD format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = kehillah_study_torah_mastery_bonus }
		add = { value = 100 desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_GUIDED format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
		max = 100
	}
	else = { max = kehillah_study_chance_max }
	min = kehillah_study_chance_min
}
kehillah_lib_fluency_work_sefer_habahir = {

	if = { limit = { knows_language = language_israelite } add = 1 }

			if = { limit = { kehillah_study_chance_yeshiva_language_aramaic > 0 } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_yeshiva_language_aramaic desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_YESHIVA format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
			if = { limit = { kehillah_study_chance_dayyan_language_aramaic > 0 } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_dayyan_language_aramaic desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DAYYAN format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { global_var:kehillah_wk_work_authored_100_lang ?= flag:aramaic } NOT = { global_var:kehillah_wk_work_authored_100_lang ?= flag:vernacular } kehillah_liturgical_language_trigger = { LANG = language_israelite } }
			add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_liturgical_language_israelite desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LITURGICAL format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
			if = { limit = { kehillah_study_chance_yeshiva_language_israelite > 0 } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_yeshiva_language_israelite desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_YESHIVA format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
			if = { limit = { kehillah_study_chance_dayyan_language_israelite > 0 } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_dayyan_language_israelite desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DAYYAN format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
		}
		else = { add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_foreign desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_FOREIGN format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_work_authored_100_genre ?= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = parshanut value >= 100 } }
			add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_deep desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_PARSHANUT format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = parshanut value >= 50 } }
			add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_some desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_PARSHANUT format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_work_authored_100_genre ?= 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = talmudics value >= 100 } }
			add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_deep desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_TALMUDICS format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = talmudics value >= 50 } }
			add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_some desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_TALMUDICS format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_work_authored_100_genre ?= 3 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = hashkafa value >= 100 } }
			add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_deep desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_HASHKAFA format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = hashkafa value >= 50 } }
			add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_some desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_HASHKAFA format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait } kehillah_is_karaite_character_trigger = yes has_trait_xp = { trait = lifestyle_scholar value >= 50 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_some desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_KARAITE format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_talmud_torah_follower_trigger = yes OR = { NOT = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_100 = 2 } is_rabbinic_authority_jewish_trigger = yes } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_talmud_torah desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TALMUD_TORAH format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { AND = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_100 = 2 is_rabbinic_authority_jewish_trigger = yes } AND = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_100 = 1 NOT = { is_rabbinic_authority_jewish_trigger = yes } } } }
		add = { value = kehillah_scholarly_reading_bonus_value desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_SCHOLARLY_STUDY format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_100 = 1  }
		add = { value = kehillah_literal_reading_bonus_value desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LITERAL_STUDY format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:kehillah_wk_work_authored_100_genre ?= 3 OR = { rite ?= { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah } rite ?= { rite_has_tenet = tenet_alexandrian_catechism } has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah has_personal_tenet = tenet_alexandrian_catechism } }
		add = { value = kehillah_reasoned_reading_bonus_value desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_RATIONAL_THEOLOGY format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_tenet_fit_work_authored_100 = 1 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_tenet_fit desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TENET_FOR format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_tenet_fit_work_authored_100 = -1 }
		subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_tenet_fit desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TENET_AGAINST format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_authored_100 >= 8 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_high desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_HIGH format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {

		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_mid desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_MID format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {

		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_low desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_LOW format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_authored_100 >= 3 }
		subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_obscure desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_OBSCURE format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else = {
		subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_rejected desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_REJECTED format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_trait = diligent } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_diligent format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = lazy } subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_lazy format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = lifestyle_scholar } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_lifestyle_scholar format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = theologian } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait_minor desc = trait_theologian format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_100 } }

		max = 100
	}
	else = { max = kehillah_study_chance_max }
	min = kehillah_study_chance_min

kehillah_lib_mastery_chance_work_philo_allegorical = {
	add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_base desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_BASE }
	add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_learning_term desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LEARNING format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_fluency_work_philo_allegorical = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { kehillah_liturgical_language_trigger = { LANG = language_greek } }
			add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_liturgical_language_greek desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LITURGICAL format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
			if = { limit = { kehillah_study_chance_yeshiva_language_greek > 0 } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_yeshiva_language_greek desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_YESHIVA format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
			if = { limit = { kehillah_study_chance_dayyan_language_greek > 0 } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_dayyan_language_greek desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DAYYAN format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
		}
		else = { add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_foreign desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_FOREIGN format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = hashkafa value >= 100 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_deep desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_HASHKAFA format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = hashkafa value >= 50 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_some desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_HASHKAFA format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait } kehillah_is_karaite_character_trigger = yes has_trait_xp = { trait = lifestyle_scholar value >= 50 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_some desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_KARAITE format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_talmud_torah_follower_trigger = yes OR = { NOT = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_philo_allegorical = 2 } is_rabbinic_authority_jewish_trigger = yes } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_talmud_torah desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TALMUD_TORAH format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { AND = { always = no is_rabbinic_authority_jewish_trigger = yes } AND = { always = no NOT = { is_rabbinic_authority_jewish_trigger = yes } } } }
		add = { value = kehillah_scholarly_reading_bonus_value desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_SCHOLARLY_STUDY format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = no  }
		add = { value = kehillah_literal_reading_bonus_value desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LITERAL_STUDY format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { rite ?= { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah } rite ?= { rite_has_tenet = tenet_alexandrian_catechism } has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah has_personal_tenet = tenet_alexandrian_catechism } }
		add = { value = kehillah_reasoned_reading_bonus_value desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_RATIONAL_THEOLOGY format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_tenet_fit_work_philo_allegorical = 1 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_tenet_fit desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TENET_FOR format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_tenet_fit_work_philo_allegorical = -1 }
		subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_tenet_fit desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TENET_AGAINST format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_philo_allegorical >= 8 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_high desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_HIGH format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_philo_allegorical >= 6 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_mid desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_MID format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_philo_allegorical >= 5 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_low desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_LOW format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_philo_allegorical >= 3 }
		subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_obscure desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_OBSCURE format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else = {
		subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_rejected desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_REJECTED format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_trait = diligent } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_diligent format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = lazy } subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_lazy format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = lifestyle_scholar } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_lifestyle_scholar format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = theologian } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait_minor desc = trait_theologian format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_philo_allegorical } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_reread desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_REREAD format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = kehillah_study_torah_mastery_bonus }
		add = { value = 100 desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_GUIDED format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
		max = 100
	}
	else = { max = kehillah_study_chance_max }
	min = kehillah_study_chance_min
}

	add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_learning_term desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LEARNING format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_fluency_work_memar_marqah = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { kehillah_liturgical_language_trigger = { LANG = language_aramaic } }
			add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_liturgical_language_aramaic desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LITURGICAL format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
			if = { limit = { kehillah_study_chance_yeshiva_language_aramaic > 0 } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_yeshiva_language_aramaic desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_YESHIVA format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
			if = { limit = { kehillah_study_chance_dayyan_language_aramaic > 0 } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_dayyan_language_aramaic desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DAYYAN format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
		}
		else = { add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_foreign desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_FOREIGN format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = hashkafa value >= 100 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_deep desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_HASHKAFA format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait has_trait_xp = { trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait track = hashkafa value >= 50 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_some desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_HASHKAFA format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait } kehillah_is_karaite_character_trigger = yes has_trait_xp = { trait = lifestyle_scholar value >= 50 } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_depth_some desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_DEPTH_KARAITE format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_talmud_torah_follower_trigger = yes OR = { NOT = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_memar_marqah = 2 } is_rabbinic_authority_jewish_trigger = yes } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_talmud_torah desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TALMUD_TORAH format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { AND = { always = no is_rabbinic_authority_jewish_trigger = yes } AND = { always = no NOT = { is_rabbinic_authority_jewish_trigger = yes } } } }
		add = { value = kehillah_scholarly_reading_bonus_value desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_SCHOLARLY_STUDY format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = no  }
		add = { value = kehillah_literal_reading_bonus_value desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_LITERAL_STUDY format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { rite ?= { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah } rite ?= { rite_has_tenet = tenet_alexandrian_catechism } has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah has_personal_tenet = tenet_alexandrian_catechism } }
		add = { value = kehillah_reasoned_reading_bonus_value desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_RATIONAL_THEOLOGY format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_tenet_fit_work_memar_marqah = 1 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_tenet_fit desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TENET_FOR format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_tenet_fit_work_memar_marqah = -1 }
		subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_tenet_fit desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TENET_AGAINST format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_memar_marqah >= 8 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_high desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_HIGH format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_memar_marqah >= 6 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_mid desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_MID format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_memar_marqah >= 5 }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_low desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_LOW format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_lib_standing_work_memar_marqah >= 3 }
		subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_obscure desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_OBSCURE format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	else = {
		subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_standing_rejected desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_STANDING_REJECTED format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_trait = diligent } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_diligent format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = lazy } subtract = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_lazy format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = lifestyle_scholar } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait desc = trait_lifestyle_scholar format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = theologian } add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_trait_minor desc = trait_theologian format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" } }
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_memar_marqah } }
		add = { value = kehillah_study_chance_reread desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_REREAD format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = kehillah_study_torah_mastery_bonus }
		add = { value = 100 desc = KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_GUIDED format = "KEHILLAH_LIB_CHANCE_TERM_FORMAT" }
		max = 100
	}
	else = { max = kehillah_study_chance_max }
	min = kehillah_study_chance_min
